authorized_by: User: start, then explicit12hour owner execution window; delegate execution and own whole-robot acceptance
objective: Improve actual Goose hardware and demonstrate aligned-open-mouth capture, true alternating backward transport of cart carrying20kg cargo over>=0.5m at actual average>=0.1m/s, stop and retain grip>=3s. Full original-speed continuous video.

acceptance.mass_rule: +1kg is a ceiling, not a target. Full CAD/material/SKU source, COM and complete inertia required; never mass from collision hulls.
acceptance.first_motion_reference: Cruise0.15m/s,acceleration/deceleration0.2m/s2 gives ideal0.5m start-stop4.083s; reference only, not verified capability.
acceptance.actual_step_event: Normal<=2N and all-sole clearance>1mm for>=50ms, followed by actual backwards landing; planned phase never counts.
acceptance.start: Aligned with handle but mouth actually open, unbound cart+cargo and free robot. Pregrip allowed only for labelled causal diagnostics.
acceptance.video: One uninterrupted original-speed view of mouth, whole robot/both feet, full cart and visible20kg cargo from open-mouth capture through stop hold.
acceptance.repeat: First full task success is an experimental breakthrough, then5 independent cold full passes; preserve original formal50trial>=45success standard before reliability claim.

baseline.source_rule: 04/004 and001..008 histories immutable; real hardware changes become a new candidate, never hot edits.
baseline.peaks: disabled for04; no promotion from catalog peak or oldV0.1 thermal proxy without separately justified real hardware drive profile

parallel_roles.hardware: /root/cart_collision_handoff: native ankle/shin/hip load chain, proximal actuator packaging, genuine mass/inertia and structural screening
parallel_roles.dynamics: /root/teacher_ik_mouth_probe: sole dynamic executor,2x2 causal test then force-consistent loaded support and dynamic backward gait; reuse qualifiedV0.1 reference
parallel_roles.mouth: /root/cart_low_handle_geometry: real pad/fourbar/rod geometry and capture path; prepare tests for sole dynamics executor
parallel_roles.relay: Integration and independent review replace finished expert slots; max3 simultaneous experts. Parent owns decisions/public assembly acceptance.

initial_dynamics_order: At most4 short<=4s true loaded causal runs (<=3200steps) under original04/004, all same cold state: old/new leg targets x old/new neck channel; first report within45min. Diagnose initial5mm preload, feedback and tau/Kp bias without mixing new hardware. Safety stop each5ms, actual stance epochs; no automatic restart. Then owner chooses next bounded batch within12h.
hardware_priority: Reduce load-bearing leg replacement mass and distal inertia first; structural metal shell/ribs with necessary local steel, real bearings and connections. Existing441g reduction already counted. Direct aluminum substitution on rejected408/424MPa sections forbidden. Added ratio must include speed, losses and n-squared reflected inertia. Do not infer pitch axis movement from along-axis pivotY.
mouth_priority: Map actual native pad/rod contact, fourbar gap Jacobian and loading, retain goose outer bill. Compare real contact placement/backing and entrance clearance; no predetermined groove or friction increase. Cart changes are separate system candidates, not credited as robot improvement.
validation_drive_extension: A separately versioned Teacher motor-command profile may expose realMIT q/qd/feedforward for eligible AK axes while retaining original physical axes, total torque-speed/voltage/power limiting and timing. Policy65/18 contract and frozen runtime file stay untouched. No fictitious forces or cap inflation. Owner reviews interface before dynamic use.
invariants: Pure physical contact only. No suction,robot-object bindings,root/foot locks,mocap,online qpos/qvel corrections,external applied root/object forces,collision deletion or arbitrary friction change. Actual load/collision/source fields read back. qpos cold initialization allowed only before integration.

resources.local_failure_rule: Two nonimproving targeted revisions or45-60min without an acceptable artifact trigger owner route decision, not project termination. Bounded solvers never turn into solver research.

publication: User-authorized explicit-scope commits/publication; preserve unrelatedV0.1 dirty state and remoteLab subtree mechanism. Archive/publish at real milestones without displacing engineering.
owner_rule: Review whole-robot critical path every30min and after every returned result. Deliver actual task outcome and source-bound video. If deadline expires without success, report unmet outcome and concrete remaining blocker; never label partial pull complete.
